# proxmox_node_ceph_monitor (Resource)

Creates and destroys a Ceph monitor through `/nodes/{node}/ceph/mon/{monid}`. Import as `<node>/<monid>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_monitor" "m" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  monid = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monid` (String) Monitor id, usually the node name.
- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Optional

- `mon_address` (String) Bind address of the monitor.

### Read-Only

- `ceph_version` (String) Ceph version of the monitor.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<monid>` form.
- `quorum` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is in quorum.
- `state` (String) Monitor state.
